title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Doug Lamarre; nak 300’s > sony d5m, fob; maxell mx90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark ADC1 24/96 > tascam HD-P2,compact flash > mac > adobe audition > fission > 16/44.1 > xACT flac; transferred and seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: A zesty, rain‑soaked first‑set capture that sounds solid despite the weather
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises a lively, “zest‑filled” performance where the band sounds in sync and attentive, especially on the first set. Although recorded during a downpour, the audio remains enjoyable enough to earn a four‑star rating, with only minor rain‑related ambience noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review gives a solid 4‑star rating, indicating both good musical performance and acceptable recording quality despite weather.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded in pouring rain; no specific soundboard or audience comments, but reviewer finds it listenable with a pleasant “zesty” vibe.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set highlighted as particularly pleasing; second set still fondly remembered by the reviewer.
